**C4 MERGED — window CLOSED, embargo LIFTED, Track C central claim PROVEN (brain owns the format, engram is a pluggable rebuildable engine)**

What: CP-C4 APPROVED and merged by the human (PR #230 → feature/v2.0.0). Independent reviewer verification: tag-contains re-run (0 — 0.6.0 migration never shipped), round-trip 275/275 on the real store with the declared issue-without-source edge honesty, idempotency by topic_key verified against engram source, embargo declared with the exact agreed wording.

THE TRANSITIONAL WINDOW IS CLOSED. THE EMBARGO IS LIFTED: memory:pull is safe again on every clone — now records-based; the chunk path no longer exists, so nothing is left to go stale. PCStaFe30-174 may resume memory:pull (records-based). [[sdd/issue-222-c2b2-cutover/cutover-complete]] embargo status = LIFTED.

TRACK C CENTRAL CLAIM PROVEN: brain OWNS the memory format (.memory/records/ = source of truth); engram is a pluggable engine that rebuilds from records/. Records-only write (dualWrite retired by deletion), records-only idempotent pull, records-only memory-gate, and the real-store round-trip contract together demonstrate interchangeability.

MAJOR-1 RESOLVED by C0 doctrine ruling: engram = regenerable cache; ts in records = temporal truth; created_at in the engine = engine metadata. The fix is UPSTREAM (engram feature request: --created-at or bulk records-import), precedent = ADR-0002 --dir. Registered as follow-up [[findings/c4-pull-created-at-restamp]].

Remaining Track C, as already-disposed own slices: C3 (plainfiles — the SECOND backend that completes the interchangeability claim), cutover finding 8 (gandalf symlink + delta reconciliation + brain:doctor guard) [[findings/8-engram-symlink-absent-write-read-gap]], skip:memory-gate [[governance/skip-memory-gate-unwired]], schemaVersion-drift guard [[findings/schemaversion-drift-repo-self]], MAJOR-1 upstream.

NEXT CAMPAIGN (agreed): BACK TO TRACK A → A2 (GitLab CI governance pipeline), the original product gap. A1/ci-context.mjs already in place. Empirical inputs from this campaign for the A2 design: frozen labels, mergeability race, exit-code contract. D2 in parallel once the human triages the auto-reverts. Where: PR #230 (merged), feature/v2.0.0.
